Nina (Sales): Handing Aperture trial to CS. 14-day trial, 4 days left. Main blockers: Okta SAML, need private-eval for PI data, and tokenizer splitting hyphenated names. Contact: jordan@aperture.ai (PST). Dealsheet link: https://redwood.co/deals/AP-901. Please own until kickoff.

Ari (CSM): Thanks Nina 64b3fb4aa4c5 looping support & eng. I'll send pre-kickoff checklist and propose 09:30am PST tomorrow. Flag: renewal_risk = medium if SSO not in place.

Luis (Support): Opening ticket SUP-3302 to collect Okta metadata. Jordan, can you attach SAML XML or grant admin console access? Needed: idp_metadata.xml or SP/ACS values. SP entityID: https://private.redwood/aperture/sp.

Tess (Eng): Quick ask: are they on hosted trial? If so, we can triage tokenizer in runtime. Please paste minimal failing example (anonymized). I'll create ENG-6820 for follow-up.

Nina (Sales): Hosted trial confirmed by Jordan. Also Jordan mentioned they need a quote for private-eval by EOD. I'll draft ballpark and send to Ari.

Onboard Bot: Ticket SUP-3302 created and playbook "ssoconfig_v2" started.

Ari (CSM): Pre-kickoff checklist posted to Jordan: 1) upload Okta metadata to SUP-3302 2) paste 10 anonymized examples showing tokenizer split 3) confirm regulatory region (US/EU) 4) decision owner for private-eval budget. Owners: Ari (kickoff + enablement), Luis (SUP-3302), Tess (ENG-6820), Nina (sales quote). Targets: metadata & examples by EOD 2024-06-03.

Jordan (Aperture): Thanks team 64c uploading metadata to SUP-3302 now. I'll add anonymized name examples. Can join kickoff at 09:30 PST.

Ari (CSM): Great 44d I'll send calendar invite and update account health to "watch". Closing this thread once SUP-3302 and ENG-6820 are in-progress.
